citations.claim: just before floor impact body falling fast downward
one step later body rebounds upward faster than it arrived, violating restitution e~0.907
total energy jumps above initial energy at first violating step

counterfactual.change: changed body restitution e from 0.907 to 0.0 only; perfectly inelastic bounce removes energy gain so energy_bound passes

explanation: Single body falls under gravity and hits arena floor between steps 60 and 61. Incoming speed ~18.67 should rebound to at most e*speed ~16.9, but rebound speed is ~19.73, larger than impact. This super-elastic floor bounce injects ~346 J, pushing total energy from ~3017 to ~3363 and exceeding E0+10%+5. Likely cause: floor impulse applies restitution to already positionally-corrected / gravity-augmented velocity or double-applies bounce over substeps, creating energy instead of dissipating.
vision_note: A single blue ball falls vertically and makes contact with the arena floor between steps 60 and 61. No tunneling, escape, or other bodies are visible, so the energy-bound violation itself is not directly visible beyond the impact moment.
